scripts.dev: concurrently -k "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.lint: npm --prefix client run lint && npm --prefix server run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run fsd:check && npm run typecheck && npm --prefix server test
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm test && docker compose config
